title: +*GENDER, RACE, AND POP CULTURE
description: Introduces students to the critical analysis of mass media and representations of women, gender, sexuality, and race in popular culture. Explores the entertainment industry, advertising, music, the internet and technology through a variety of lenses including feminist, queer, film, and disability theories.
